metadata.description: Writing skills: install one genre skill (writing-tech or writing-personal) and the language skills you write in (writing-en, writing-ja, writing-zh)

plugins.name: writing-tech
plugins.description: Rules for technical text in any language: docs, READMEs, runbooks, code comments, commit messages, PR descriptions, error and log text, postmortems

plugins.name: writing-personal
plugins.description: Rules for personal writing in any language: blog posts, essays, newsletters, social posts

plugins.name: writing-en
plugins.description: English-only rules; use with writing-tech or writing-personal

plugins.name: writing-ja
plugins.description: Japanese-only rules; use with writing-tech or writing-personal

plugins.name: writing-zh
plugins.description: Chinese-only rules; use with writing-tech or writing-personal
